lines.beaver_en: Hello. May I have your name?
lines.en: Hello. My name is Yuki Tanaka.

lines.beaver: 네, 유키 씨. 국적도 적어 주세요.
lines.beaver_en: Okay, Yuki. Please write your nationality too.
lines.beaver_roman: ne, yuki ssi. gukjeokdo jeogeo juseyo.
lines.en: I'm Japanese. I'll write Japan for nationality.

lines.beaver_en: Thank you. Please mark the gender box too.

lines.beaver: 그리고 이 행사는 성인만 참가할 수 있어요.
lines.beaver_en: Also, only adults can join this event.
lines.beaver_roman: geurigo i haengsaneun seonginman chamgahal su isseoyo.
lines.en: I'm twenty-five, so I'm an adult.

lines.beaver_en: Good. Do you have anyone with you?
lines.learner: 네, 중국인 친구 왕웨이도 같이 왔어요.
lines.en: Yes, my Chinese friend Wang Wei came too.
lines.roman: ne, junggugin chingu wangweido gachi wasseoyo.

lines.beaver_en: Where is Wang Wei right now?
lines.en: The person in the suit over there is Wang Wei.

lines.beaver: 아, 보여요. 오늘은 참가자가 정말 많네요.
lines.beaver_en: Ah, I see him. There are so many participants today.
lines.beaver_roman: a, boyeoyo. oneureun chamgajaga jeongmal manneyo.
lines.en: Yes, there are a lot of young people.

lines.learner: 저는 학생이에요. 한국어는 배우면 배울수록 재미있어요.
lines.en: I'm a student. The more I learn Korean, the more fun it is.
lines.roman: jeoneun haksaengieyo. hangugeoneun baeumyeon baeulsurok jaemiisseoyo.

lines.beaver: 좋네요. 이름표 여기 있어요. 가슴에 달아 주세요.
lines.beaver_en: Nice. Here's your name tag. Please put it on your chest.
lines.beaver_roman: jonneyo. ireumpyo yeogi isseoyo. gaseume dara juseyo.
lines.learner: 네, 이름표를 달았어요. 친구 것도 주세요.
lines.en: Okay, I put on the name tag. Please give me my friend's too.
lines.roman: ne, ireumpyoreul darasseoyo. chingu geotdo juseyo.

lines.beaver_en: Here you go. Enjoy the event.
lines.en: Thank you. I'll have a great time!
